title: 8 Signs a Godly Man Judges Himself Louder Than He Judges You
caption:
The scoreboard is supposed to only run one direction.

A godly man replays his own bad moment for days and forgets yours by dinner. He apologizes first even when the math says fifty-fifty. He notices his own sin before he ever notices yours.

Matthew 7:3 isn't a suggestion, it's a mirror. Grace for you, honesty for himself. That's the split most guys have backwards.

#faith #grace #godlyman #christianmen #humility
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
